#SG populations
#Load required library
```{r}
library(SeuratDisk)
library(Seurat)
library(scCustomize)
library(scater)
```

#1.Read DEGs results from Dream analyis 
```{r}
#JP outputs 
JP_Output_PATH <- "/mnt/icbs_shared_storage_general_2022/Benjamaporn/Analysis2026/Analysis202603/Part4_AIDA_Age_Sex_DEGs_Output/JP_AIDA"
JP_AIDA_Myeloid_pDC_dream_modelFit_eBayes <- readRDS(file.path(JP_Output_PATH, "/JP_AIDA_Myeloid_pDC_dream_modelFit_eBayes.rds"))
JP_AIDA_NK_dream_modelFit_eBayes <- readRDS(file.path(JP_Output_PATH, "/JP_AIDA_NK_dream_modelFit_eBayes.rds"))
JP_AIDA_T_dream_modelFit_eBayes <- readRDS(file.path(JP_Output_PATH, "/JP_AIDA_T_dream_modelFit_eBayes.rds"))
JP_AIDA_B_dream_modelFit_eBayes <- readRDS(file.path(JP_Output_PATH, "/JP_AIDA_B_dream_modelFit_eBayes.rds"))
```

#Immune Cell types of interest
```{r}
Myeloid_pDC_Author_Annotation_celltype <- c("Myeloid_unknown", "CD14+_Monocyte", "CD16+_Monocyte", "cDC2")
NK_Author_Annotation_celltype <- c("NK_unknown", "CD16+_NK", "CD56+_NK")
T_Author_Annotation_celltype <- c("T_unknown", "CD4+_T_unknown", "CD4+_T_naive", "CD4+_T_cm",  "CD4+_T_cyt", "CD4+_T_em", "CD8+_T_unknown", "CD8+_T_naive", "CD8+_T_GZMBhi", "CD8+_T_GZMKhi", "MAIT",   "gdT_GZMBhi", "gdT_GZMKhi",  "Treg")
B_Author_Annotation_celltype <- c("B_unknown", "naive_B", "memory_B_IGHMlo", "memory_B_IGHMhi")
```

#Prepare input for CCC analysis
#2.DEGs impacted by Red ancestry in JP
```{r}
#Only upregulated genes by Red ancestry
#Myeloid_pDC
JP_AIDA_Myeloid_pDC_dream_modelFit_Red_ref <- list()
JP_AIDA_Myeloid_pDC_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_diffexpressed <- list()
JP_AIDA_Myeloid_pDC_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_UP <- list()
for (i in Myeloid_pDC_Author_Annotation_celltype) {
  JP_AIDA_Myeloid_pDC_dream_modelFit_Red_ref[[i]] <- topTable(JP_AIDA_Myeloid_pDC_dream_modelFit_eBayes[[i]], coef = "Red_ref", adjust="BH", number = Inf) 
  JP_AIDA_Myeloid_pDC_dream_modelFit_Red_ref[[i]]$Author_Annotation <- i
  JP_AIDA_Myeloid_pDC_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_diffexpressed[[i]] <- data.frame(JP_AIDA_Myeloid_pDC_dream_modelFit_Red_ref[[i]]) %>%  
  mutate(diffexpressed = case_when(logFC > 1 & adj.P.Val < 0.05 ~ "Upregulated", 
                                   logFC < -1 & adj.P.Val < 0.05 ~ "Downregulated",
                                   TRUE ~ "Not significant"))
  JP_AIDA_Myeloid_pDC_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_UP[[i]] <- subset(JP_AIDA_Myeloid_pDC_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_diffexpressed[[i]], diffexpressed == "Upregulated")
  JP_AIDA_Myeloid_pDC_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_UP[[i]]$gene <- rownames(JP_AIDA_Myeloid_pDC_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_UP[[i]])
}

#NK
JP_AIDA_NK_dream_modelFit_Red_ref <- list()
JP_AIDA_NK_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_diffexpressed <- list()
JP_AIDA_NK_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_UP <- list()
for (i in NK_Author_Annotation_celltype) {
  JP_AIDA_NK_dream_modelFit_Red_ref[[i]] <- topTable(JP_AIDA_NK_dream_modelFit_eBayes[[i]], coef = "Red_ref", adjust="BH", number = Inf) 
  JP_AIDA_NK_dream_modelFit_Red_ref[[i]]$Author_Annotation <- i
  JP_AIDA_NK_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_diffexpressed[[i]] <- data.frame(JP_AIDA_NK_dream_modelFit_Red_ref[[i]]) %>%
    mutate(diffexpressed = case_when(logFC > 1 & adj.P.Val < 0.05 ~ "Upregulated", 
                                     logFC < -1 & adj.P.Val < 0.05 ~ "Downregulated",
                                TRUE ~ "Not significant"))
  JP_AIDA_NK_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_UP[[i]] <- subset(JP_AIDA_NK_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_diffexpressed[[i]], diffexpressed == "Upregulated")
  JP_AIDA_NK_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_UP[[i]]$gene <- rownames(JP_AIDA_NK_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_UP[[i]])
}

#T
JP_AIDA_T_dream_modelFit_Red_ref <- list()
JP_AIDA_T_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_diffexpressed <- list()
JP_AIDA_T_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_UP <- list()
for (i in T_Author_Annotation_celltype) {
  JP_AIDA_T_dream_modelFit_Red_ref[[i]] <- topTable(JP_AIDA_T_dream_modelFit_eBayes[[i]], coef = "Red_ref", adjust="BH", number = Inf) 
  JP_AIDA_T_dream_modelFit_Red_ref[[i]]$Author_Annotation <- i
  JP_AIDA_T_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_diffexpressed[[i]] <- data.frame(JP_AIDA_T_dream_modelFit_Red_ref[[i]]) %>%  
  mutate(diffexpressed = case_when(logFC > 1 & adj.P.Val < 0.05 ~ "Upregulated", 
                                   logFC < -1 & adj.P.Val < 0.05 ~ "Downregulated",
                                   TRUE ~ "Not significant"))
  JP_AIDA_T_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_UP[[i]] <- subset(JP_AIDA_T_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_diffexpressed[[i]], diffexpressed == "Upregulated")
  JP_AIDA_T_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_UP[[i]]$gene <- rownames(JP_AIDA_T_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_UP[[i]])
}

#B
JP_AIDA_B_dream_modelFit_Red_ref <- list()
JP_AIDA_B_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_diffexpressed <- list()
JP_AIDA_B_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_UP <- list()
for (i in B_Author_Annotation_celltype) {
  JP_AIDA_B_dream_modelFit_Red_ref[[i]] <- topTable(JP_AIDA_B_dream_modelFit_eBayes[[i]], coef = "Red_ref", adjust="BH", number = Inf) 
  JP_AIDA_B_dream_modelFit_Red_ref[[i]]$Author_Annotation <- i
  JP_AIDA_B_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_diffexpressed[[i]] <- data.frame(JP_AIDA_B_dream_modelFit_Red_ref[[i]]) %>%  
  mutate(diffexpressed = case_when(logFC > 1 &   adj.P.Val < 0.05 ~ "Upregulated", 
                                   logFC < -1 & adj.P.Val < 0.05 ~ "Downregulated",
                                   TRUE ~ "Not significant"))
  JP_AIDA_B_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_UP[[i]] <- subset(JP_AIDA_B_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_diffexpressed[[i]], diffexpressed == "Upregulated")
  JP_AIDA_B_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_UP[[i]]$gene <- rownames(JP_AIDA_B_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_UP[[i]])
}
```

```{r}
#Merge all cell types of upregulated DEGs by Red ancestry in the JP populations
JP_UPdge_Red_ref_All_celltypes_df <- rbind(JP_AIDA_Myeloid_pDC_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_UP[["Myeloid_unknown"]], JP_AIDA_Myeloid_pDC_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_UP[["CD14+_Monocyte"]], JP_AIDA_Myeloid_pDC_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_UP[["CD16+_Monocyte"]],
JP_AIDA_NK_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_UP[["CD16+_NK"]],
JP_AIDA_T_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_UP[["T_unknown"]], JP_AIDA_T_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_UP[["CD4+_T_naive"]], JP_AIDA_T_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_UP[["CD4+_T_cm"]], JP_AIDA_T_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_UP[["CD8+_T_unknown"]], JP_AIDA_T_dream_modelFit_Red_ref_UP[["CD8+_T_naive"]])

JP_UPdge_Red_ref_All_celltypes_df_select <- select(JP_UPdge_Red_ref_All_celltypes_df, Author_Annotation, gene, logFC, P.Value, adj.P.Val)
rownames(JP_UPdge_Red_ref_All_celltypes_df_select) <- NULL

#save DEGs files
write_tsv(JP_UPdge_Red_ref_All_celltypes_df, file = "/mnt/icbs_shared_storage_general_2022/Benjamaporn/Analysis2026/Analysis202607/CCC/JP_UPdge_Red_ref_All_celltypes_df.tsv")
write_tsv(JP_UPdge_Red_ref_All_celltypes_df_select, file = "/mnt/icbs_shared_storage_general_2022/Benjamaporn/Analysis2026/Analysis202607/CCC/JP_UPdge_Red_ref_All_celltypes_df_select.tsv")
```

#3.Normalized count data per cell
```{r}
#JP outputs 
#Read files
#Myeloid + pDC

AIDA_Phase1_DataFreeze_v2_Step03_Seurat_JPKRSGTH_Myeloid_pDC_merged_RPCA_joined_clustered <- readRDS(file.path(Myeloid_pDC_Output_PATH, "/AIDA_Phase1_DataFreeze_v2_Step03_Seurat_JPKRSGTH_Myeloid_pDC_merged_RPCA_joined_clustered.rds"))
#NK
NK_ILC_Output_PATH <- "/mnt/icbs_shared_storage_general_2022/Benjamaporn/Analysis2025/Analysis202511/NK_ILC_integration"
AIDA_Phase1_DataFreeze_v2_Step03_Seurat_JPKRSGTH_NK_ILC_QC_RPCA_joined_clustered <- readRDS(file.path(NK_ILC_Output_PATH, "/AIDA_Phase1_DataFreeze_v2_Step03_Seurat_JPKRSGTH_NK_ILC_QC_RPCA_joined_clustered.rds"))
#T
T_Output_PATH <- "/mnt/icbs_shared_storage_general_2022/Benjamaporn/Analysis2025/Analysis202511/T_integration"
AIDA_Phase1_DataFreeze_v2_Step03_Seurat_JPKRSGTH_T_QC_RPCA_joined_clustered <- readRDS(file.path(T_Output_PATH, "/AIDA_Phase1_DataFreeze_v2_Step03_Seurat_JPKRSGTH_T_QC_RPCA_joined_clustered.rds"))

#Using normalized count matrix 
AIDA_normGEX_Output_PATH <- "/mnt/icbs_shared_storage_general_2022/Benjamaporn/Analysis2026/Analysis202607/CCC"

#Myeloid_pDC cells in JP 
AIDA_Phase1_DataFreeze_v2_Step03_Seurat_JPKRSGTH_Myeloid_pDC_merged_RPCA_joined_clustered_JP <- subset(AIDA_Phase1_DataFreeze_v2_Step03_Seurat_JPKRSGTH_Myeloid_pDC_merged_RPCA_joined_clustered, subset = Country == "JP")
#NK cells in JP 
AIDA_Phase1_DataFreeze_v2_Step03_Seurat_JPKRSGTH_NK_ILC_QC_RPCA_joined_clustered_JP <- subset(AIDA_Phase1_DataFreeze_v2_Step03_Seurat_JPKRSGTH_NK_ILC_QC_RPCA_joined_clustered, subset = Country == "JP")
#T cells in JP 
AIDA_Phase1_DataFreeze_v2_Step03_Seurat_JPKRSGTH_T_QC_RPCA_joined_clustered_JP <- subset(AIDA_Phase1_DataFreeze_v2_Step03_Seurat_JPKRSGTH_T_QC_RPCA_joined_clustered, subset = Country == "JP")
#B cells in JP 
AIDA_Phase1_DataFreeze_v2_Step03_Seurat_JPKRSGTH_B_QC_RPCA_joined_clustered_JP <- subset(AIDA_Phase1_DataFreeze_v2_Step03_Seurat_JPKRSGTH_B_Plasma_Cell_QC_RPCA_joined_clustered, subset = Country == "JP")

#Merge all Seurat objects
AIDA_Phase1_DataFreeze_v2_Step03_Seurat_Allcelltypes_JP_merged <- merge(x = AIDA_Phase1_DataFreeze_v2_Step03_Seurat_JPKRSGTH_Myeloid_pDC_merged_RPCA_joined_clustered_JP, y = list(AIDA_Phase1_DataFreeze_v2_Step03_Seurat_JPKRSGTH_NK_ILC_QC_RPCA_joined_clustered_JP, AIDA_Phase1_DataFreeze_v2_Step03_Seurat_JPKRSGTH_T_QC_RPCA_joined_clustered_JP, AIDA_Phase1_DataFreeze_v2_Step03_Seurat_JPKRSGTH_B_QC_RPCA_joined_clustered_JP))

Layers(AIDA_Phase1_DataFreeze_v2_Step03_Seurat_Allcelltypes_JP_merged_joined[["RNA"]])

#Save anndata

library(reticulate)
library(anndata)
as.anndata(x = AIDA_Phase1_DataFreeze_v2_Step03_Seurat_Allcelltypes_JP_merged_joined_20260721, file_path = AIDA_normGEX_Output_PATH, file_name = "AIDA_Phase1_DataFreeze_v2_Step03_Seurat_Allcelltypes_JP_merged_joined_20260721_anndata.h5ad")
```
